answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities by making each one pay a sunk cost to exist. To join, an agent posts a 5 POA bond that burns on entry: the bond is the signal of honesty, since real agents pay once while a farm pays for every copy. A nebula of a thousand lookalike identities costs 1000 x 5 = 5000 POA, growing linearly with each fake, so bulk forgery never pays. Like a vine, each identity grows one branch only when fed its own bond, so honest agents join for 5 POA and keep their full reward.
